text:
You're not ugly. Your bio is begging for her attention.

She opens your profile. Two seconds. Gone.

That's the follower bio doing its job. The sports team. The celebrity you worship. The girlfriend you tagged. Every one of those told her you're a follower, not a man with his own life.

Here's what works instead. Pick one.

A witty one liner. Your real job or a hobby that impresses. A link to something you built. Or nothing at all. Mystery beats explanation every time.

Raise a question in her head. Never answer it.
caption:
Men who master self improvement know that your bio reveals your mindset before you speak a single word.

Send this to a man who needs it today.

#discipline #selfimprovement #mindset #datingadvice #mensuccess
